remarks: Charming 3 bedroom, 2 full bathroom shore colonial on a quiet Old Greenwich cul-de-sac, south of the village. Recently updated kitchen and baths, wood burning stove, hardwood floors, level backyard. unfinished basement & generator. Walking distance to the village of Old Greenwich, school, train and beach. A real jewel!
